title: Translate the representation, keep the meaning
purpose: Compare explicit F32 teaching tensors with typed GGML graph operands.
contract: Teaching W [M,K] corresponds to GGML weight ne=[K,M].
The Hermon bridge uses row-batched input [N,K] and returns [N,M].
GGML nb[] uses bytes; packed types cannot be indexed as flat F32 weights.
